cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: The Handoff Already Happened
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility by returning to earlier offers until the task seems to have been assigned all along.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Remember volunteering to finish the last detail of the fete? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. The banner announces a raffle nobody has organised.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And 'raffle' is the word still needing the most work.

mechanism: A directs a fete by interpreting B banner commitment as responsibility for the raffle it advertises, then offers support to keep that handoff plausible.
confusable: Simple delegation does not repeatedly return to the exact earlier wording to make the new job seem already accepted.
comparison: The wedding alternative reduces a broad handoff to known guests; this one supplies resources while keeping the advertised event with B.
seedUse: Banner seed supplies the word raffle as an unfinished responsibility; S02 helps acquire supplies rather than just asserting authority.
